ranking_data_expansion.condition: v14: stage-1 data scale, 1M -> 1.98M pairs at the proven 512d

unsupervised_pretraining.caveat: volume-matched control for nocrop-v15: EXACTLY the same 548,619 pairs, but crop-heavy (30.6%) with cross-passage held to the v14 share (1.8% vs 32.4%). This is the only pair in the set that varies composition at fixed volume, so it is the arm that decides whether composition or volume produced the v14 effect.
unsupervised_pretraining.design_note: this arm alone does not separate composition from volume. The separating comparison is nocrop-v15 vs cropmatched-v15: both are exactly 548,619 pairs, differing only in crop share (0% vs ~30%) and cross-passage share (32.4% vs 1.8%). balancedfull-v15 then measures what the extra 1.37M crops are worth on top.
unsupervised_pretraining.first_sentence_relabel_note: the first-sentence/inverse-cloze reorder is a RELABELING, not new signal: for the leading sentence both constructions emit byte-identical query and document, and the pair sums are equal (340,973+2,562 = 287,994+55,541 = 343,535). Attribute nothing to it.
unsupervised_pretraining.objective: in-batch cross entropy (MNRL); no teacher scores
unsupervised_pretraining.source: approved Tagalog corpus; inverse cloze + title + first-sentence + cross-passage + independent crop
unsupervised_pretraining.supersedes_confounded_comparison: the v14 1M arm had no cross-passage or first-sentence pairs at all and also used a different --inverse-cloze-per-passage (363,544 vs the 340,973 every other build exhausts at), so its +0.83 held-out deficit to the 2M arm confounds at least three changes with volume
